Learning it

In the project's comprehension study, assistants were given the shipped guides and five small tasks. Across 17 runs none took a wrong turn; four tasks closed in every run, and the fifth was reworded after early runs and then closed in its three reruns. That measures assistants, not people: whether a person can learn Guion from the guides and make a realistic change is not yet tested.

The receipts are in the repository under evaluation/comprehension/receipts. Learnability is still listed as an open outcome on the project status page.
